description: This line plot illustrates the similarity scores across different model layers for four language pair combinations: en&en, en&es, en&el, and en&bn. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and ranges from 0 to 22, with major tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Similarity," is also linear, spanning from 0.00 to 0.45, with major grid lines at intervals of 0.05. Four distinct lines are plotted: the "en&en" pair is represented by a solid brown line, "en&es" by a solid blue line, "en&el" by a solid green line, and "en&bn" by a solid purple line. All four lines exhibit a similar trend, starting at low similarity values near 0.05 at Layer 0, rising to a peak around Layer 6 (with "en&en" reaching approximately 0.27 and "en&es" around 0.25), then declining to a trough near Layer 18 (around 0.05 for all), before experiencing a sharp, steep increase in the final layers, culminating in a dramatic spike at Layer 22 where "en&en" reaches approximately 0.44, "en&bn" reaches 0.30, and "en&es" reaches 0.27. The "en&el" line follows a similar trajectory but remains slightly lower than the others in the final ascent, ending at approximately 0.30.
